summary: Iteration 6 e2e validation of the TWO-TIER delivery scope: (1) local Sorel-Tracy + 5 km + 30 $ min, (2) extended Rive-Sud / Rive-Nord / Montréal / autres régions for events/large orders with distance/volume/besoins pricing. Backend: 30/30 pytest passing (added 4 new two-tier tests + adjusted the stale iter-5 Nancy-delivery test that used to forbid Rive-*/Montréal). Frontend: Delivery section has 2 cards (delivery-local + delivery-event) with all required copy; Hero desktop AND mobile (390x844) show 'Livraison locale à Sorel-Tracy — plus loin sur demande pour vos événements'; Footer shows 'Sorel-Tracy · Livraison étendue sur demande pour événements' and does NOT list Montréal/Rive-*; FAQ delivery answer mentions both tiers (Sorel-Tracy + 5 km + 30$ AND Rive-Sud/Rive-Nord/Montréal + distance/volume); /politique-livraison Section 1 has both subsections and the 'Aucune adresse personnelle, adresse de production ou point de retrait public' disclaimer; Nancy Montréal question returns event/large-order guidance with distance/volume pricing (no flat refusal); Nancy small-order-in-Sorel-Tracy pushes toward 30$ minimum; Cookie banner + PostHog gating works; Order submission via UI end-to-end succeeded (order 42be0202-... visible in admin with Combo Découverte @ 10 $). Zero restrictive-phrasing residue; zero street address / postal code leak.
